player_prompt.intro:
U ngi Player {player_id} eka JoJoJoin, yiyingetiwa eka borada ya 5x5 na maseli ya 0-24.
Eka wena ku endla, beka chapa ya wena eka seli yin'wana yin'wana leyi nga na nchumu, xikombiso '[12]'.
U WINA hi ku kuma maseli ya nne ya chapa ya wena eka mstari — maseli ya nne ya mfuleni, ya le hansi, kumbe ya diagonal.
Tanihi Player {player_id} u ngi '{symbol}'; mungoni wa wena ngi '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ku rhurha loku ku rhumeriweke a hi ka muxaka lowu faneleke.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} a hi sele leyi nga tirhiki. Yi fanele yi va exikarhi ka 0 na 24.

game_action.placed: Mfiri {player_id} u hakele xiviko xakwe ({symbol}) eka seli {cell}.

outcome.draw: Ntlangu wu ve na ku ringana!
